basis: renders role="grid" with role="row"/"columnheader"/"gridcell" semantics over a native <table> by default, or over a windowed div-grid when virtualized — the windowed grid re-states the full size with aria-rowcount/aria-colcount plus per-row aria-rowindex so the partial DOM reads as the whole grid; sortable headers are labelled <button>s and selection rides row checkboxes.

exceptions.because: e2e/focus-not-obscured.e2e.ts (WCAG 2.4.11) covers three pages today — button, dialog, drawer; this page joins when that suite's population grows (tracked in ecoma-io/loom#308)

interaction.basis: cells, sort headers and selection managed as one grid contract; PageUp/PageDown page the roving stop a window at a time and scroll the focused row into view, Ctrl+End jumps to the last row.
